comparison.objective: Candidate tunes a shock absorber; record pours beads through a hand-held funnel.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires precision keyed adjustment, counterholding, torque-limited locking, and cycling; record requires bimanual funnel alignment and controlled granular pouring.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate has explicit energy, velocity, travel, repetition, damage, and drift limits. Board record omits setup, scoring, required bead quantity, spill tolerance, and run limit.
comparison.reason: Granular transfer and spill avoidance test a different physical outcome from dynamic deceleration and setting retention.
